---
title: "Overall survival — primary preparation"
subtitle: "Locked 182-day survival endpoint"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The wide cohort dataset already contains survival time and event status derived
at the fixed data lock. This stage selects the SAP covariates and creates the
deterministic ECOG and mGPS variables used downstream.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-os-data
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))

force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
input_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
output_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "prepared.parquet"
)
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || !file.exists(output_path)) {
  prepared <- arrow::read_parquet(input_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  prepared$ecog_binary <- derive_ecog_binary(prepared$ecog_fstcnt)
  prepared$mgps <- derive_mgps(
    prepared$albumin,
    prepared$c_reactive_protein
  )
  prepared <- prepared[c(
    "id", "tx", "survival_time_days", "event_death", "ecog_binary",
    "ecog_fstcnt", "stage_binary", "lung", "mgps", "age", "gender",
    "albumin", "bilirubin", "c_reactive_protein", "lactate_dehydrogenase"
  )]
  arrow::write_parquet(prepared, output_path)
}
```
